meaning: Help me and let me help you — cooperation and interdependence
note: Alongside “Benkum dware nifa na nifa nso adware benkum”: the left hand washes the right and the right washes the left.
aliases: Boa Me Na Me Mmoa Wo
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
